prompts.slash:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production 2D Japanese anime hand-drawn action-game VFX animation SPRITE ATLAS.
Create ONE square transparent RGBA PNG sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 animation frames. Uniform invisible grid: no drawn lines, borders, text, numbers or labels. Read order is left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Keep every effect centered on its OWN cell's exact center at a consistent scale with NO camera or center wobble. Each cell has a completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutter of at least 16 final pixels on all four sides. Never bridge adjacent cells.
Visual style: sharp clean hand-drawn sakuga slash animation, bold intentional curved masses, tapered needle tips, directional streaks, crisp boundaries, controlled antialiasing. White-to-gray ONLY, white 255 hottest thin leading edge, medium gray body, darker neutral gray (around 90) outer wake. Distinct value bands, not an all-white silhouette. No black painted pixels, hue/color, fog, diffuse bloom, film grain, random specks or dither. All unused space must be truly transparent alpha 0, not black background or checkerboard artwork. No weapon, person, floor, shadow, text, labels, spritesheet frame boxes, photographic smoke or 3D. Frames must evolve as ONE coherent animation, not 16 unrelated icons.
Specific asset: FX_WhirlwindSlash_Atlas, a great axe's circling SLASH WAKE only. Final sheet 2048x2048; each frame 512x512.
View from DIRECTLY ABOVE: perfect circular path, NOT an ellipse. Within every cell, center=(256,256), brightest OUTER cutting edge follows radius 205px. Broad blade mass fans INWARD from that circle. Thin wind splinters may extend to radius 230px, still keeping 16px gutters.
CRITICAL DIRECTION: the broadest, brightest LEADING HEAD stays FIXED at 3 O'CLOCK (RIGHT of cell center) in all frames 0 through 11. The tail extends CLOCKWISE DOWNWARD from the head: 3 o'clock -> 6 o'clock -> 9 o'clock -> 12 o'clock. It becomes thinner, darker, then ends in sharp tips. DO NOT rotate the head from frame to frame. The game rotates the entire image; this sheet animates growth, shape and breakup only. Do not put the head at the bottom, top or left.
Explicit row-major frames:
Row 1, frames 0,1,2,3: tiny sharp 30-degree clockwise arc at the RIGHT; 60-degree arc; 90-degree arc; 150-degree arc. Fixed right leading edge and fixed center/radius in every cell.
Row 2, frames 4,5,6,7: 190-degree clockwise tail; 230-degree tail; 270-degree tail; 300-degree tail. Broadening inward, clear white outer blade edge, midgray curved body, darkgray outer fringes; add just 2 or 3 thin curved internal speed grooves.
Row 3, frames 8,9,10,11: hold approximately 300-degree clockwise crescent sweep with 70-90px maximum inward body width. Fixed WHITE LEADING HEAD at RIGHT. Slightly varying sharp wind fringes, NOT identical stamps. Nearly complete ring but with a distinct leading head and tapered tail, NOT a uniform donut.
Row 4, frames 12,13,14,15: the same sweep tears into a few long pointed wind ribbons; breaks into fewer smaller gray tapered shards; sparse tiny remnants; almost EMPTY with only 2 or 3 small dim-gray ribbon fragments. Preserve the established center. No flash or new effect in the last frame.
